query: DELETE FROM tenant_generation_schedule WHERE tenant_id IN ( SELECT s.tenant_id FROM tenants AS t JOIN tenant_generation_schedule AS s ON s.tenant_id = t.id WHERE t.state = 'deleted' AND t.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.tenant_id = t.id AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED)
